# Sky Shield Defense

> Sky Shield Defense delivers mission-critical protective coatings, counter-drone systems and integrated security governance for governments, military forces and critical infrastructure operators worldwide. 30+ years of experience, 2,000+ certified professionals, active operations in 80+ countries.

## Capabilities

- [Protect](https://www.skyshielddefense.com/protect.html): Industrial protective coatings — polyurea, polyurethane and epoxy systems for military assets, pipelines, offshore platforms and critical infrastructure
- [Detect & Intercept](https://www.skyshielddefense.com/detect.html): AI-powered counter-drone detection and interception systems including AEROSENTRY, AERODOME, SKYFENCE and AEROTRACKER products
- [Secure](https://www.skyshielddefense.com/secure.html): Integrated security governance combining physical, digital and personnel security for embassies, governments and critical enterprises
